newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi king in Jeddah on way to holy site.
newsitem.headline: Saudi king in Jeddah on way to holy site.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's King Fahd left the capital Riyadh to Jeddah on his way to spend the last days of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan in the holy city of Mecca, the official Saudi Press Agency reported on Tuesday.
SPA said the weekly cabinet meeting, usually held on Monday, would take place instead on Thursday in Mecca as the custom is during Ramadan every year.
King Fahd traditionally spends the last 10 days of Ramadan, which this year is expected to end in the second week of February, in holy sites in western Saudi Arabia.
